title: Provisioning lock-out absent: node does not persistently reject further provisioning until factory reset (spec 8.7)
description: Requirement (spec/06-security.md:217, BR-provisioned security requirements): Node rejects further provisioning (factory reset to reset). Classification: not-implemented. Evidence: no persistent provisioning-lock flag in any language; enforcement is per-session state machine only (rust/lichen-oscore/src/provisioning.rs:788-790 rejects invalid state transitions but a fresh session can be constructed; python/src/lichen/crypto/provisioning.py similar; grep provisioning_locked / factory-reset = 0 hits). Suggested placement: identity store plus provisioning resource (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/provisioning.py, C app_identity identity_store.h, rust lichen-oscore provisioning.rs). BR-provisioning is an optional flow, hence P3.
